We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces an SN2 reaction: C-N formed and C-Cl broken, breaking a halide functional group. The target molecule is given: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes "halide"? functional_groups_formed includes "C-N"? Also bonds broken: C-Cl. bonds formed: C-N.

We need to get a template that matches retrosynthetic step (i.e., forward reaction is nucleophilic substitution). Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.

Let's call with molecule_smiles = target. functional_groups_broken: maybe "halide". functional_groups_formed: maybe "C-N". bonds_broken: "C-Cl". bonds_formed: "C-N". limit maybe 5.
